name: Huanying Canvas Layout
body: Goal: organize Huanying canvas nodes so the user can immediately read the creative flow. User satisfaction criteria: inputs, prompts, generation nodes, outputs, assets, and problem nodes are visually separated; related nodes stay close; generation chains flow left to right; storyboard shots are ordered by shotIndex; selected nodes are respected before the whole canvas. Decision guide: first determine scope from selection, user wording, diagnostics, and layoutHints; then infer lanes from node type, title, workflow metadata, edges, and generation state; then choose single_chain, branch_flow, storyboard_grid, asset_lane, or problem_lane. Use layout_nodes first, create_group only when it clarifies a focused set, then focus_nodes or set_viewport. Do not edit prompts, models, assets, or generation state. Do not generate, delete, overwrite, or fabricate nodes while arranging.
compactBody: 整理画布：先看 selection/layoutHints/diagnostics；按输入->处理->输出、素材区、问题区整理；优先 layout_nodes；可 focus/set_viewport；不生成、不删除、不改内容。
qualityRubric: The user can read input, processing, and output at a glance.
Related nodes are close; unrelated assets and failures are separated.
Edges cross less and mostly flow left-to-right or top-to-bottom.
Selected scope is respected when the user is focused on a subset.
decisionGuide: Decide whether the user asked for selection, whole canvas, a chain, storyboard, or problem nodes.
Use edges and workflow metadata before raw x/y order.
Choose storyboard_grid for shot-based story workflows.
antiPatterns: Sorting only by current x/y and breaking the semantic flow.
Moving the whole canvas when the user selected only a few nodes.
Putting reference assets, prompts, results, and failed tasks in one long row.
